title: Blue Wins When Red Splits
description: Both ingredients are Blue+, but they give opposite Red results with their partners. Which colour wins?

hints.text: Two-colour rule: ing1 is B+ and ing2 is B+. Blue signs match — the result must be Blue or Red.
Now check Red. ing1 mixes R- with ing3, so ing1 is R-. ing2 mixes R+ with ing4, so ing2 is R+. Opposite Red signs mean Red cannot resolve.
Red is ruled out. Blue signs matched and sizes differ (ing1 is B+S, ing2 is B+L) — Blue resolves. Both are B+, so the result is B+.
